pages.title: INTRODUCTION TO MEMGPT: UNLOCKING AI MEMORY
pages.content: Generative AI evolves but struggles with long-term memory.
pages.image_prompt: An abstract representation of a neural network with digital brain imagery, showcasing the concept of artificial intelligence evolving. Incorporate ethereal lines and glowing nodes connecting various parts of the brain, symbolizing the struggle and potential of generative AI to achieve long-term memory. The background should be filled with soft, futuristic light patterns that suggest evolution and advancement in AI technology.

pages.title: MEMGPT: A BREAKTHROUGH FRAMEWORK FOR MEMORY
pages.content: MemGPT equips models like GPT-4 with extended memory.
pages.image_prompt: A futuristic, sophisticated digital interface displaying an AI language model surrounded by cloud-like storage units symbolizing extended memory. Include elements like data streams and binary code cascading around the AI model, illuminating the breakthrough concept of MemGPT's framework which empowers models like GPT-4 with enhanced memory capabilities. The scene should evoke a sense of innovation and engineering marvel.

pages.title: HOW MEMGPT WORKS: VIRTUAL MACHINE APPROACH
pages.content: MemGPT uses a multi-level memory like human memory.
pages.image_prompt: A detailed visualization of a virtual machine operating system with layered structures akin to human brain convolutions. Depict a multi-level memory architecture with labeled sections such as Core Memory, Recall Memory, and Archival Memory. The image should illustrate data transfer between layers using light beams or digital strands, symbolizing how MemGPT employs a human-like memory structure.

pages.title: THE POWER OF SYSTEM PROMPTING IN MEMGPT
pages.content: Prompts guide the model’s memory use effectively.
pages.image_prompt: An imaginative depiction of an AI interface with a central 'system prompt' guiding a vast network of interconnected nodes. The nodes should resemble memory cells, demonstrating the flow of information and memory retrieval in a colorful, dynamic array. This setup represents the power of system prompting within MemGPT to effectively manage the AI's enhanced memory usage.

pages.title: KEY CAPABILITIES: ENHANCING AI THROUGH MEMGPT
pages.content: MemGPT enables persistence, recall, and action abilities.
pages.image_prompt: A dynamic scene showing an AI assistant interacting with various modules that represent memories, actions, and personas. Use vibrant colors to differentiate segments labeled as persistence, recall, and action capabilities. The AI should be depicted as an advanced digital persona engaging with these modules in real-time, portraying the holistic enhancement of AI functions through MemGPT.
